title: SchcChannel port boundary test blocked by SCHC profile constraints
description: Review finding #4 requested a test for UDP port boundary values (0, 1, 65535). The implementation correctly accepts ports 1-65535 at the Endpoint layer, but the SCHC compression layer (compress_packet in schc/headers.py) uses MSB matching against port 5683 for the link-local CoAP rule. Non-standard ports fail compression with 'MSB target_value mismatch'. Either the SCHC profile needs a rule for arbitrary ports, or this limitation should be documented.
